items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: had pretty good subs, like, you know, Joe Pass, John Gray, Al Viola.

ctx.x: Oh, that was around '68, '67, '68, '69, around in there. In the meantime I was working at the China Trader with Bobby Troop, but I could always leave and come back, and had pretty good subs, like, you know, Joe Pass, John Gray, Al Viola.
